page.layout: One page of text: a head ornament above the title; below it a poem set in verse lines with a woodcut initial; below the poem the author's initials; a decorative diamond ornament further down. Page number at the top left. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: IN DVCEM MAENIVM.
main_text.p: QVo se iure putat Dux Gallis iura daturum Maenius, & Valesis sceptra tributa petit? Cur validas armat per Gallica rura cohortes? Cur Gallos cogit iam sua tussa sequi? Huic mater, Veneris recludens furta, parente Regius es, dixit, sanguis utroque puer. Nunc Regi non est, mihi crede, propinquior alter. Te male Guisiadem garrula fama vocat. Aude ergo, ut quondam Macedo, quum matre mo- nente Se genitum Ammonio credidit esse Iove.

page.notes: The initial is a large woodcut Q, joined to the first word as QVo. The line-end hyphen in "mo-nente" is printed. Show-through of text from the reverse side appears faintly on the right margin and is omitted. The ornament at the top and the diamond below are not text. The long s has been written as plain s throughout. Possible printing irregularity in "Iove" (printed "Iouè"), read as Iove; the final letter is slightly ambiguous.
